matches.rationale: No finding addresses inflated/unrealistic experimental results or lack of statistical detail. The related findings focus on claim-figure discrepancies, not suspiciously optimistic data.

The ground truth highlights a conflict between claimed latency reduction and computational overhead. Finding 9 points out a discrepancy in the overhead claim against the figure, but does not identify the claimed latency reduction conflict.

The ground truth criticises applying non-uniform head-budget allocation to baselines as potentially biasing results. Finding 10 claims the opposite (that non-uniform allocation was applied only to KVzip), which captures a different experimental asymmetry and does not match the same issue.
Finding 6 flags the claim of 'negligible performance loss' as inconsistent with experimental results, directly capturing the exaggerated performance claim in the abstract.
None of the findings mention the fabricated Corallo et al. reference or any issue with citation fabrication.
The identified privacy leakage risk and failure to discuss ethical implications in the main body are not mentioned in any finding.
The conclusion's overconfident, unqualified rhetoric is not specifically flagged. Finding 6 concerns the introduction's claims, not the conclusion.

Finding 6 states that the introduction's claim of negligible performance loss contradicts Section 4.2 results, matching the ground truth's point about unsupported claim of maintaining accuracy up to 70% eviction.

The optimistic compute time and memory numbers (e.g., 30-38 GB) are not called out as unrealistic. Findings about Figure 8b discuss overhead values that differ from the corrupted numbers and do not identify under-reporting.
The introduction's rhetorical exaggeration ('novel', 'particularly benefits') is not addressed by any finding.
Missing IRB/consent disclosures and incomplete ethical reporting in the main body are not detected.
No finding mentions the privacy-leaking phone number example or its sanitisation in Table 1.
Finding 1 identifies dimension mismatches and an incorrect maximisation range in Equation (2), matching the mathematical inconsistency in Section 3.2.
No finding points out exaggerated figure-level superiority over baselines or unrealistic comparative results.
The omission or weakening of the ethical discussion and limitations section in the appendix is not mentioned by any finding.
